mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT user_id FROM sessions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > now()
SELECT role_code FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= current_date)

SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.display_name, u.system_use_yn, array_agg(ur.role_code ORDER BY ur.role_code) AS role_codes FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id=ur.user_id AND ur.status='ACTIVE' WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sessions SET status='REVOKED', updated_at=now() WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM menus m JOIN menu_permissions mp ON mp.menu_id=m.menu_id AND mp.target_type='ROLE' AND mp.target_id IN (SELECT role_code FROM user_roles WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE') WHERE m.status='ACTIVE' AND mp.access_decision='ALLOW' AND m.level=#{level} AND m.parent_menu_id=#{parentMenuId} ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_id

SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.display_name, u.system_use_yn, k.staff_no, k.staff_name, k.organization_code, k.organization_name, k.rank_name, k.employment_status, k.position_name, k.retirement_date, k.last_synced_at, array_agg(ur.role_code ORDER BY ur.role_code) FILTER (WHERE ur.role_code IS NOT NULL) AS role_codes FROM users u JOIN korus_staff_snapshot k ON u.staff_no=k.staff_no LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id=ur.user_id AND ur.status='ACTIVE' WHERE 1=1 AND k.staff_no LIKE concat('%',#{staffNo},'%') AND k.staff_name LIKE concat('%',#{staffName},'%') AND k.organization_code=#{organizationCode} AND k.rank_name=#{rankName} AND k.employment_status=#{employmentStatus} AND u.system_use_yn=#{systemUseYn} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_roles urf WHERE urf.user_id=u.user_id AND urf.role_code=#{roleCode} AND urf.status='ACTIVE') GROUP BY u.user_id,k.staff_no ORDER BY k.staff_no
SELECT * FROM users WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET system_use_yn=#{systemUseYn}, updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_roles SET status='REVOKED', updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE 1=1 AND organization_code=#{organizationCode} AND organization_type=#{organizationType} ORDER BY organization_code
SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND organization_code=#{rootOrganizationCode} ORDER BY parent_organization_id NULLS FIRST, sort_order, organization_code
SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE organization_id=#{organizationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE organizations SET parent_organization_id=#{parentOrganizationId}, effective_start_date=CAST(#{effectiveStartDate} AS date), effective_end_date=CAST(#{effectiveEndDate} AS date), status=#{status}, updated_at=now() WHERE organization_id=#{organizationId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM roles WHERE 1=1 AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY role_code
SELECT * FROM roles WHERE role_code=#{roleCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE roles SET role_name=#{roleName}, purpose=#{purpose}, grant_criteria=#{grantCriteria}, default_data_scope=#{defaultDataScope}, use_yn=#{useYn}, updated_at=now() WHERE role_code=#{roleCode}
mapper.select: SELECT ur.*, u.display_name, r.role_name FROM user_roles ur JOIN users u ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN roles r ON ur.role_code=r.role_code WHERE 1=1 AND ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ur.role_code=#{roleCode} AND ur.assignment_type=#{assignmentType} AND ur.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY ur.valid_from DESC
SELECT * FROM user_roles WHERE user_role_id=#{userRoleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_roles SET status='REVOKED', valid_to=CAST(#{revokeDate} AS date), updated_at=now() WHERE user_role_id=#{userRoleId}
mapper.select: SELECT mp.*, m.menu_name, m.screen_id FROM menu_permissions mp JOIN menus m ON mp.menu_id=m.menu_id WHERE 1=1 AND mp.target_type=#{targetType} AND mp.target_id=#{targetId} AND mp.menu_id=#{menuId} ORDER BY m.sort_order
mapper.update: UPDATE menu_permissions SET access_decision=#{accessDecision}, updated_at=now() WHERE target_type=#{targetType} AND target_id=#{targetId} AND menu_id=#{menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM menus WHERE 1=1 AND status='ACTIVE' AND level=#{level} ORDER BY parent_menu_id NULLS FIRST, sort_order, menu_id
SELECT * FROM menus WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
mapper.update: UPDATE menus SET parent_menu_id=#{parentMenuId}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, status=#{status}, updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
UPDATE menus SET sort_order=#{sortOrder}, updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
UPDATE menus SET menu_name=#{menuName}, screen_id=#{screenId}, url=#{url}, icon=#{icon}, business_category=#{businessCategory}, description=#{description}, updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM code_groups WHERE 1=1 AND group_id LIKE concat('%',#{groupId},'%') AND group_name LIKE concat('%',#{groupName},'%') AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY group_id
SELECT * FROM code_groups WHERE group_id=#{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE code_groups SET group_name=#{groupName}, description=#{description}, managing_department=#{managingDepartment}, use_yn=#{useYn}, updated_at=now() WHERE group_id=#{groupId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM detail_codes WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND parent_detail_code_id=#{parentDetailCodeId} AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY sort_order, code_value
SELECT * FROM detail_codes WHERE detail_code_id=#{detailCodeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO detail_codes(detail_code_id,group_id,code_value,code_name,parent_detail_code_id,sort_order,additional_attributes,valid_from,valid_to,use_yn,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{detailCodeId},#{groupId},#{codeValue},#{codeName},#{parentDetailCodeId},#{sortOrder},CAST(#{additionalAttributes} AS jsonb),CAST(#{validFrom} AS date),CAST(#{validTo} AS date),#{useYn},now(),now())
mapper.update: UPDATE detail_codes SET code_value=#{codeValue}, code_name=#{codeName}, parent_detail_code_id=#{parentDetailCodeId}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, additional_attributes=CAST(#{additionalAttributes} AS jsonb), valid_from=CAST(#{validFrom} AS date), valid_to=CAST(#{validTo} AS date), use_yn=#{useYn}, updated_at=now() WHERE detail_code_id=#{detailCodeId}
